correctness.rationale: Checked the all-rank proof directly. With P=0102, the three images under sigma cubed are P followed by D_0=010, D_1=01, D_2=empty. In sigma cubed applied to T_(k-3), the initial P and each successive D_a P are exactly the complete greedy arches, so their number and the number of 2s are both r. T_m ends in 01, 02, 10 for m=1,2,3; the recurrence T_m=T_(m-1)T_(m-2)T_(m-3) repeats these two-letter suffixes for m>=4. Consequently the penultimate symbol is 0 or 1, giving a final complete arch whose binary prefix embeds 11; the last symbol yields the stated tail. Every length-r word embeds one symbol per arch. For length r+1, group any binary-to-2 adjacent pair in one arch; otherwise the word is 2^t followed by a binary block. If that block has length at least two, group a non-11 adjacent pair in its assigned arch, or, for an all-1 block, its last pair in the last arch. A block of length zero overuses 2, and one of length one must use the final tail. This exhausts the words and proves both the minimum length and exact list. Independent direct subsequence enumeration at k=4,5,6, covering all residue classes, agreed (branches/check_tribonacci.py and .log); the replay is not the all-rank argument.
residual_risks: No claim for shifted prefixes or outside the specified ranks and full alphabet.

value.rationale: For a standard morphic word, the exact missing language at the universality boundary is more useful than the already-known boundary length: the proof gives a single structural description at every rank, shows why the count changes with rank modulo 3, and identifies the only obstructions among exponentially many candidate words. The pair-packing argument is independently useful for other arch families meeting the same local conditions.
residual_risks: No extension to all epistandard or multinacci words is claimed.
